record.field:
IKOS Techs · Odoo Integration Help

1) Connection

This telecontrol does not connect to any API, endpoint, database, or external service.

All readings are generated locally inside Odoo using a deterministic synthetic model designed for soil moisture probes.

2) Expected Setup in Odoo

  1. Configure connection_params on this remote control record (see section 3 below).
  2. Run the procedure IKOS Techs: Provision humidity probes to auto-create all devices and sensors.
  3. Alternatively, create devices manually, assign Remotecontrol = IKOS Techs, and add sensors named Sensor 10, Sensor 20, Sensor 30.
  4. Use sensor type Sensor de humedad with unit %.

3) Remote Control Configuration (connection_params)

Edit the connection_params JSON on this record to control the provisioning behaviour:

{
  "num_devices": 4,
  "device_prefix": "Sonda de humedad",
  "location_prefix": "Sector",
  "start_date": "2026-03-21",
  "sensors": [
    {"name": "Sensor 10", "depth_cm": 10},
    {"name": "Sensor 20", "depth_cm": 20},
    {"name": "Sensor 30", "depth_cm": 30}
  ]
}
  • num_devices: number of probe devices to create (default: 4). Set to 50 for a large community.
  • device_prefix: prefix for device names (default: Sonda de humedad). Devices will be named prefix 1, prefix 2, etc.
  • location_prefix: prefix for the location field (default: Sector).
  • start_date: initial date for synthetic readings. If omitted, defaults to 45 days before today.
  • sensors: list of sensors to create per device. Each entry can be a plain string ("Sensor 10") or an object with name and optional depth_cm. If omitted, creates Sensor 10 / 20 / 30.

4) Daily Procedure

The included daily procedure works in two steps:

  1. Get devices (plan) → finds IKOS sensors in Odoo and calculates the missing time range.
  2. Generate readings → creates realistic hourly soil moisture readings and upserts them into Odoo.

5) How Sensor Depth Is Detected

The depth is obtained in this order:

  1. From sensor.remotecontrol_params.depth_cm
  2. From the first number found in the sensor name (for example, Sensor 10)

6) Optional Device Configuration

In each Device (mdm.measurement.device) you can optionally define:

{
  "start_date": "2026-05-01",
  "field_capacity": 36.5,
  "wilting_point": 11.2,
  "baseline_shift": 0.8,
  "irrigation_bias": 0.04
}
  • start_date: initial local date for the first generated readings if no data exists yet.
  • field_capacity: upper realistic limit after irrigation/rain events.
  • wilting_point: lower realistic dry threshold.
  • baseline_shift: shifts the general moisture level for that probe.
  • irrigation_bias: adjusts the probability of synthetic irrigation events.

7) Optional Sensor Configuration

In each Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) you can optionally define:

{
  "depth_cm": 10,
  "start_date": "2026-05-01",
  "dryness_bias": -0.4
}
  • depth_cm: overrides the depth inferred from the name.
  • start_date: overrides the device start date.
  • dryness_bias: small per-sensor offset to make one depth slightly wetter or drier.

8) Synthetic Model

  • 10 cm: most reactive sensor, strongest daily oscillation, dries faster.
  • 20 cm: intermediate response, smoother than 10 cm.
  • 30 cm: most stable sensor, delayed reaction and slower decay after irrigation.
  • The system simulates seasonality, daily evapotranspiration cycles, and synthetic irrigation / rain events.
  • The model is deterministic: if the same device, sensor, and timestamp are generated again, the value is reproduced consistently.

9) Scheduling

The daily procedure is preconfigured with a 1-day interval.

To create the scheduled job, open the procedure IKOS Techs: Daily Sync and click Save Cron, exactly like the other telecontrol modules.

10) Output

Each execution creates an audit JSON attachment on the IKOS Techs remote control record with the generated ranges and counters.

11) Default Provisioning

The module includes a provisioning procedure driven by connection_params (see section 3). By default it creates:

  • N devices (controlled by num_devices, default 4): Sonda de humedad 1 … Sonda de humedad N
  • category_id = 1 on every device (first available category as fallback)
  • 3 sensors per device (controlled by sensors): Sensor 10, Sensor 20, Sensor 30
  • remotecontrol_params with start_date so readings are generated from the first run

The provisioning is idempotent: if a probe or sensor already exists, it is updated instead of duplicated.

Remote = self.remote_id Device = env['mdm.measurement.device'] Sensor = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] Category = env['mdm.measurement.device.category']
# Read provisioning configuration from Remote.connection_params try: remote_cfg = json.loads(Remote.connection_params or '{}') or {} except Exception: remote_cfg = {}
try: num_devices = max(1, int(remote_cfg.get('num_devices', 4) or 4)) except Exception: num_devices = 4
device_prefix = remote_cfg.get('device_prefix') or u'Sonda de humedad' location_prefix = remote_cfg.get('location_prefix') or u'Sector'
# Sensors: supports ["Sensor 10"] or [{"name": "X", "depth_cm": 10}] sensors_raw = remote_cfg.get('sensors') or [ {'name': u'Sensor 10', 'depth_cm': 10}, {'name': u'Sensor 20', 'depth_cm': 20}, {'name': u'Sensor 30', 'depth_cm': 30}, ] sensor_templates = [] for s in sensors_raw: if isinstance(s, dict): sensor_templates.append(s) else: sensor_templates.append({'name': s})
# Start date: from connection_params or default 45 days ago if remote_cfg.get('start_date'): start_date = remote_cfg['start_date'] else: today_date = fields.Date.from_string(fields.Date.today()) start_date = fields.Date.to_string(today_date - timedelta(days=45))
category = Category.browse(1) if not category or not category.exists(): category = Category.search([], limit=1) if not category: raise Exception( 'No measurement device category was found. Create one before ' 'running the provisioning procedure.')
SensorType = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor.type'] all_types = SensorType.with_context(active_test=False, lang=False).search([]) all_type_names = [(t.id, repr(t.name)) for t in all_types] sensor_type = False for t in all_types: if t.name and u'humedad' in t.name.lower(): sensor_type = t break if not sensor_type: raise Exception( u'Sensor type not found. Available types: %s' % all_type_names)
created_devices = 0 updated_devices = 0 created_sensors = 0 updated_sensors = 0 device_results = []
for i in range(1, num_devices + 1): device_name = u'%s %s' % (device_prefix, i) location = u'%s %s' % (location_prefix, i)
device_params = {'start_date': start_date} device_vals = { 'name': device_name, 'description': ( u'IKOS Techs synthetic humidity probe automatically provisioned ' u'for demo and telecontrol generation.' ), 'location': location, 'brand': u'IKOS Techs', 'model': u'Synthetic Soil Moisture Probe', 'category_id': category.id, 'remotecontrol_id': Remote.id, 'remotecontrol_params': json.dumps( device_params, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), 'active': True, }
device = Device.with_context(active_test=False).search([ ('name', '=', device_name), ('remotecontrol_id', '=', Remote.id), ], limit=1) if device: device.write(device_vals) updated_devices += 1 else: device = Device.create(device_vals) created_devices += 1
sensor_names = [] for sensor_tpl in sensor_templates: s_name = sensor_tpl.get('name') or u'' sensor_params = {'start_date': start_date} if sensor_tpl.get('depth_cm'): sensor_params['depth_cm'] = int(sensor_tpl['depth_cm'])
sensor_vals = { 'name': s_name, 'device_id': device.id, 'type_id': sensor_type.id, 'remotecontrol_params': json.dumps( sensor_params, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), 'active': True, } sensor = Sensor.with_context(active_test=False).search([ ('device_id', '=', device.id), ('name', '=', s_name), ], limit=1) if sensor: sensor.write(sensor_vals) updated_sensors += 1 else: Sensor.create(sensor_vals) created_sensors += 1 sensor_names.append(s_name)
device_results.append({ 'device_name': device_name, 'location': location, 'category_id': category.id, 'start_date': start_date, 'sensor_names': sensor_names, })
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'num_devices': num_devices, 'created_devices': created_devices, 'updated_devices': updated_devices, 'created_sensors': created_sensors, 'updated_sensors': updated_sensors, 'devices': device_results, }
audit_json = json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) attachment = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': 'ikostech_provision_%s.json' % ( fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_')), 'datas_fname': 'ikostech_provision.json', 'datas': base64.b64encode(audit_json.encode('utf-8')), 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
Remote.message_post( body=u'[IKOS Techs] Provision completed: %s devices (%s created, %s updated), %s sensors (%s created, %s updated)' % ( num_devices, created_devices, updated_devices, created_sensors + updated_sensors, created_sensors, updated_sensors, ), attachment_ids=[attachment.id], )
bag['created_devices'] = created_devices bag['updated_devices'] = updated_devices bag['created_sensors'] = created_sensors bag['updated_sensors'] = updated_sensors bag['provision_attachment_id'] = attachment.id

from datetime import timedelta import hashlib import math
Remote = self.remote_id Sensor = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or []
if not plan: bag['generated_readings'] = 0 Remote.message_post( body=u'[IKOS Techs] No readings generated because the plan is empty.') else: madrid_tz = pytz.timezone('Europe/Madrid') total_upserts = 0 sensor_summaries = [] device_profiles = {}
def _to_unicode(value): try: return unicode(value) except Exception: try: return str(value).decode('utf-8', 'replace') except Exception: return u''
def _json_loads(raw_value): try: return json.loads(raw_value or '{}') or {} except Exception: return {}
def _hash_float(parts, low=0.0, high=1.0): seed = u'|'.join([_to_unicode(part) for part in parts]) digest = hashlib.md5(seed.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:8] ratio = int(digest, 16) / 4294967295.0 return low + ((high - low) * ratio)
def _cfg_float(config, key, default): try: return float(config.get(key, default)) except Exception: return float(default)
def _season_factors(day_of_year): summer = ( math.sin((2.0 * math.pi * (day_of_year - 172)) / 365.0) + 1.0 ) / 2.0 winter = 1.0 - summer return summer, winter
def _depth_profile(depth_cm): # dry_baseline_offset: cm above wilting_point when no event # decay_hours: how fast moisture drops back to dry baseline defaults = { 10: { 'dry_baseline_offset': 1.0, 'seasonal_sensitivity': 1.5, 'daily_amplitude': 0.50, 'event_delay': 0.5, 'rise_hours': 0.5, 'decay_hours': 4.0, 'event_factor': 1.00, }, 20: { 'dry_baseline_offset': 4.0, 'seasonal_sensitivity': 1.0, 'daily_amplitude': 0.20, 'event_delay': 2.0, 'rise_hours': 1.5, 'decay_hours': 14.0, 'event_factor': 0.85, }, 30: { 'dry_baseline_offset': 5.0, 'seasonal_sensitivity': 0.8, 'daily_amplitude': 0.12, 'event_delay': 3.0, 'rise_hours': 2.5, 'decay_hours': 22.0, 'event_factor': 0.72, }, 60: { 'dry_baseline_offset': 8.0, 'seasonal_sensitivity': 0.5, 'daily_amplitude': 0.06, 'event_delay': 6.0, 'rise_hours': 4.0, 'decay_hours': 42.0, 'event_factor': 0.58, }, 90: { 'dry_baseline_offset': 11.0, 'seasonal_sensitivity': 0.3, 'daily_amplitude': 0.03, 'event_delay': 10.0, 'rise_hours': 6.0, 'decay_hours': 72.0, 'event_factor': 0.45, }, } if depth_cm in defaults: return defaults[depth_cm] factor = max(0.0, min(1.0, (float(depth_cm) - 10.0) / 80.0)) return { 'dry_baseline_offset': 1.0 + factor * 10.0, 'seasonal_sensitivity': max(0.2, 1.5 - factor * 1.2), 'daily_amplitude': max(0.02, 0.5 - factor * 0.47), 'event_delay': 0.5 + factor * 9.5, 'rise_hours': 0.5 + factor * 5.5, 'decay_hours': 4.0 + factor * 68.0, 'event_factor': max(0.40, 1.0 - factor * 0.60), }
def _get_device_profile(device_record): if device_record.id in device_profiles: return device_profiles[device_record.id]
config = _json_loads(device_record.remotecontrol_params) profile = { 'field_capacity': _cfg_float( config, 'field_capacity', 35.5 + _hash_float([device_record.id, 'field_capacity'], 0.0, 3.5), ), 'wilting_point': _cfg_float( config, 'wilting_point', 10.8 + _hash_float([device_record.id, 'wilting_point'], 0.0, 2.8), ), 'baseline_shift': _cfg_float( config, 'baseline_shift', _hash_float([device_record.id, 'baseline_shift'], -1.4, 1.4), ), 'irrigation_bias': _cfg_float( config, 'irrigation_bias', _hash_float([device_record.id, 'irrigation_bias'], -0.03, 0.08), ), } if profile['wilting_point'] > (profile['field_capacity'] - 3.0): profile['wilting_point'] = profile['field_capacity'] - 3.0 device_profiles[device_record.id] = profile return profile
def _get_event(device_record, local_date): profile = _get_device_profile(device_record) date_key = local_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') summer, winter = _season_factors(local_date.timetuple().tm_yday) irrigation_prob = 0.10 + (summer * 0.18) + profile['irrigation_bias'] if irrigation_prob < 0.07: irrigation_prob = 0.07 if irrigation_prob > 0.40: irrigation_prob = 0.40 rain_prob = 0.02 + (winter * 0.10)
irrigation_draw = _hash_float([device_record.id, 'irrigation', date_key]) rain_draw = _hash_float([device_record.id, 'rain', date_key])
if irrigation_draw < irrigation_prob: return { 'kind': 'irrigation', 'hour': int(round( _hash_float([device_record.id, date_key, 'irrigation_hour'], 4.0, 7.0))), 'magnitude': _hash_float( [device_record.id, date_key, 'irrigation_magnitude'], 14.0, 24.0), } if rain_draw < rain_prob: return { 'kind': 'rain', 'hour': int(round( _hash_float([device_record.id, date_key, 'rain_hour'], 0.0, 6.0))), 'magnitude': _hash_float( [device_record.id, date_key, 'rain_magnitude'], 8.0, 14.0), } return False
def _compute_value(device_record, sensor_record, depth_cm, utc_dt): local_dt = pytz.UTC.localize(utc_dt).astimezone(madrid_tz) device_profile = _get_device_profile(device_record) depth_profile = _depth_profile(depth_cm) sensor_cfg = _json_loads(sensor_record.remotecontrol_params) dryness_bias = _cfg_float(sensor_cfg, 'dryness_bias', 0.0) summer, winter = _season_factors(local_dt.timetuple().tm_yday)
# Dry state baseline: where soil settles when no recent event dry_baseline = ( device_profile['wilting_point'] + depth_profile['dry_baseline_offset'] + device_profile['baseline_shift'] + _hash_float([device_record.id, depth_cm, 'baseline'], -0.8, 0.8) + dryness_bias - depth_profile['seasonal_sensitivity'] * summer ) diurnal_cycle = -depth_profile['daily_amplitude'] * math.sin( (2.0 * math.pi * (local_dt.hour - 6)) / 24.0)
value = dry_baseline + diurnal_cycle
for day_lag in range(0, 7): event_date = local_dt.date() - timedelta(days=day_lag) event = _get_event(device_record, event_date) if not event: continue
hours_since_event = ( (day_lag * 24.0) + local_dt.hour + (local_dt.minute / 60.0) - event['hour'] ) if hours_since_event < 0.0: continue
response_hours = hours_since_event - depth_profile['event_delay'] if response_hours < 0.0: continue
rise_factor = 1.0 - math.exp( -response_hours / depth_profile['rise_hours']) decay_factor = math.exp( -response_hours / depth_profile['decay_hours']) event_contribution = ( event['magnitude'] * depth_profile['event_factor'] * rise_factor * decay_factor ) if event['kind'] == 'rain': event_contribution *= 0.85 + (winter * 0.30) value += event_contribution
value += _hash_float( [sensor_record.id, utc_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), 'micro'], -0.22, 0.22, )
if value > device_profile['field_capacity']: value = device_profile['field_capacity'] if value < device_profile['wilting_point']: value = device_profile['wilting_point'] return round(value, 2), local_dt
for item in plan: sensor = Sensor.browse(item.get('sensor_id')) if not sensor or not sensor.exists() or not sensor.device_id: continue
depth_cm = int(item.get('depth_cm') or 0) start_dt = fields.Datetime.from_string(item.get('start_dt')) end_dt = fields.Datetime.from_string(item.get('end_dt')) if start_dt > end_dt: continue
current_dt = start_dt sensor_count = 0 first_value = False last_value = False first_local = False last_local = False
while current_dt <= end_dt: value, local_dt = _compute_value( sensor.device_id, sensor, depth_cm, current_dt)
upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', { 'sensor_id': sensor.id, 'measurement_time': current_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), }, { 'value': value, } ) total_upserts += 1 sensor_count += 1
if first_value is False: first_value = value first_local = local_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') last_value = value last_local = local_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') current_dt += timedelta(hours=1)
sensor_summaries.append({ 'device_name': sensor.device_id.name, 'sensor_name': sensor.name, 'depth_cm': depth_cm, 'generated_points': sensor_count, 'first_local_time': first_local, 'last_local_time': last_local, 'first_value': first_value, 'last_value': last_value, })
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'planned_sensors': len(plan), 'generated_readings': total_upserts, 'skipped_sensors': bag.get('skipped_sensors') or [], 'sensor_summaries': sensor_summaries, }
json_str = json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) encoded = base64.b64encode(json_str.encode('utf-8')) fname = 'ikostech_generation_%s.json' % ( fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_')) attachment = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': encoded, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id, })
Remote.message_post( body=u'[IKOS Techs] Generated synthetic readings: sensors=%s readings=%s' % ( len(plan), total_upserts), attachment_ids=[attachment.id], ) bag['generated_readings'] = total_upserts bag['generation_attachment_id'] = attachment.id
